1197.description: From a standing start, sit the hips backward and bend the knees, then return to tall. The thighs and glutes take the load while you rehearse a steady lower-body shape.
instructions: Set a shoulder-wide stance and angle the toes outward a little.
Reach the hips backward as the knees bend and the torso lowers.
Stop at the deepest position you can control, with the heels down and the chest up.
Push the floor away until you are standing tall again.
Let the knees travel in the same direction as the toes.
